BEF:STATSB. Citizenship is included with Household information as it is updated at the same time, but is related to the person, not the household. Tokens shared with Background.

We create primary, self-employed or wage-receiver employment indicators to contextualize the events, as codes are reused across employment types. For primary employment, the occupation columns are AKM:DISCO08_ALLE_INDK_13 and AKM:DISCO_ALLE_INDK_13, and the industry columns are AKM:NACE_DB07_13, AKM:NACE_13, and AKM:BRANCHE_77. For wage-receivers, the occupations columns are AKM:DISCO08_LOEN_INDK, AKM:DISCOLOEN_INDK, and the industry columns are AKM:NACEA_DB07, AKM:NACEA, and AKM:BRCHL. For self-employed, the occupations columns are AKM:DISCO08_SEL_INDK AKM:DISCOSEL_INDK, and the industry are AKM:NACEI_DB07 AKM:NACEI AKM:BRCHI.
AKM:SOCIO13 and AKM:SOCIO_GL are included with the primary occupation event. There are 21 SOCIO13 codes and 51 SOCIO_GL codes.
See type for columns used. There are 207 DISCO08 3-digit codes and 36 DISCO 2-digit codes. DISCO08 codes are also shared with Employment & income. We remove codes that specify unknown.

See type for columns used. There are 279 DB07 3-digit tokens, 57 NACE 2-digit tokens, and 39 BRANCHE77 2-digit codes. DB07 codes are also shared with Employment & income. We remove codes that specify unknown.
We bin IND:FORMREST and IND:FORMREST_NY05 within years. When both occur, we only include the newest.
AMRUN:DISCO_KODE, which are DISCO08 codes, not DISCO codes. We include 3 digits. Tokens shared with Employment.
AMRUN:ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07. We include 3 digits. Tokens shared with Employment.
AMRUN:TILSTAND_KODE_AMR. We remove codes which always map to the same socio-economic status to prevent double-encoding of information.
LPR_ADM:AKTIONSDIAGNOSE. We use 5 digit Danish ICD-10 codes, which broadly corresponds to 4 digit international ICD-10 codes due to being prefixed with a D.
We use 5 digit ATC codes from LMDB:ATC.
